segments.text: I am asaditha sahajya vidya.
Now the one who has achieved this kind of pure knowledge of universal God consciousness.
For him, jagrat diti yikara, wakefulness is not other than his own real nature of consciousness.
Wakefulness is another formation of his universal consciousness.
The state of wakefulness, the state of wakefulness, by the state of wakefulness, we should know not
only the state of wakefulness, but the state of dreaming state and sound sleep also.
These three states which are experienced in our daily life are not other than universal
God consciousness, for such a yogi.
Jagrat diti yikara, it is another formation of his being, diti a another formation of
his karabing, re, this is another formation of his expansion of self.
Jagrat is not separate, Jagrat is not foreign matter to him.
Jagrat is on the contrary, his expansion of universal self in another way, another way, another
formation.
The divinity that you get in your universal, in the state of universal God consciousness, that
divinity is in the same measure found in the wakefulness in dreaming state and in dreamless
state, such as swishvati, for such a yogi, not for everybody.
Labdhav pishudvi dhyam, after achieving the state of pure knowledge, that ayikad dhivya
avdhav, when oneness with that supreme knowledge is pervaded by yogi, that ayikad, ayikad means
oneness.
When oneness is pervaded by yogi, jaguru kaha, he is always a hair of his universal consciousness.
So, that state of jagratavasta, that state of wakefulness, for such a yogi, is dhidiyam.
Second way of his being, second way of his establishment of being, yadanda amresham, although it is
found in thisness, it is not found in this state of wakefulness, it is not found in ayikad
consciousness, it is found in thisness, not ayinness, there is not ay, there is this, ay is found
only in your being.
There will be that state of God consciousness, just ayikad, ayinness will be just state of God
consciousness, this is universal God consciousness.
This is universal consciousness, so thisness is also absorbed in it, it is diluted, it
is digested in that universal God consciousness.
God consciousness only digests eye, eye consciousness, but on the country universal God consciousness
digests eye and this also, ayinness is found in equal same scale, the way it is the same,
the gravity of both are the same.
So it is another way of his being, Vedavabhasaatma kum jagat.
So this Vedavabhasaatma kum jagat, this objective world, this whole objective world, is for
such a yogi, another way of his being, another way of his universal consciousness, tattkaro
rashmi ryesya tattavido bhavti, he finds that it is another ray of my universal consciousness.
Hence, visham masya sudidity kalpamsvarti, this whole universe, yes for such a yogi, his
own expansion of being, so did it kalpams, his own didity, his own sparks, this whole universe
you are only the sparks of his being, not separate from him.
Yatuvtham tri vigyana bairava, it is said also in vigyana bairava tantra, yatra yatra ke margine
chaithanyam vijeti vibu tashitanyamat darmi tto tchitlayat bairita atmatat, the consciousness
of universal god, vibu chaithanyam, that consciousness, universal consciousness of god, yatra yatra
akhymargine vijeti, he is experienced in each and every way of this organic field, in organic
action, akhymarg, akhymarg is the way of your organs, shavts per shrutras and gand, hearing,
tasting, touching, smelling, tasting, seeing, this is akhymarg, and in all these akhymargas,
in all these ways, he finds the consciousness of universal god, for him tashitanyamat darmi
tto, because he is the aspects of universal god, for him are always present, in absence also,
he finds the presence of universal god consciousness, in absence of universal god consciousness, he
is being present, because he is aware that universal god consciousness is not existing
here, so it is existing, in negation, it is existing, because negation also exists in universal
god consciousness, but not in god consciousness only, in god consciousness, negation of god
consciousness is discarded, in universal god consciousness, negation and affirmation
of is there, it is digested, everything is digested, if you know universal god consciousness,
that is there, if you don't know that is there, knowing and not knowing is also existing
there, because not knowing is also existing in that supreme being, not knowing cannot remain
exist without that universal god consciousness, because not knowing is also existing in universe,
whatever is found in universe, it exists in universal consciousness, so there is nothing to discard,
there is nothing to put aside from your consciousness, this is what he means here, so
tanmatr dar mitat, when that universal god consciousness is your own aspect, his aspect,
the aspect, the main aspect of that yogi, chitlayath, baritathmatr, his universal consciousness is
filled everywhere, baritathmatr, everywhere, it is filled everywhere, it is never absent,
in absence also it is not absent, if it is absent, it means it is existing there also,
because absence of universal consciousness is existing and that too exists in universe of consciousness,
so absence also is present, it is also said in sarva mangala shastra, shaktis, shaktiman,
shaiva, padarth, dhyam, uchcati, shaktayos, jagat, krsnam, shaktiman, to Maheshwara,
there are two aspects only found in this universe, one energy and next energy holder,
the energy holder is lord shiva, energy is shakti of lord, energy and energy holder,
these are two aspects found in this universe, out of these two, shaktayos, jagat, krsnam,
energy is held in each and every part of universe, shaktayos, jagat, krsnam,
this whole universe is in fact energy of lord shiva, the whole universe is everything,
whatever you feel, whatever you hear, whatever you find in daily routine of,
daily way of life, that is energy, that is the existence of energy,
shaktiman, energy holder, that lord shiva is Maheshwara himself,
so nothing is lost, when you lose something, you experience that there is something less,
but that lessening is also there, but that lessening if it is found in the way of awareness,
that lessening also will improve the functioning of that God consciousness,
universal God consciousness, lessening of your consciousness,
when your consciousness is lessening day by day, and you are aware of it,
nothing is lost, when a mad man is mad, completely mad and he knows that he is mad,
he is not mad, he is aware of that he is mad, he is not mad at all,
as long as he is unaware of his madness, he is mad, he is considered to be mad from other's point of view,
for him he is not mad, when he is aware that he is actually mad, he is not mad,
when he is aware he has lessened his nature of self, he has not lessened it,
because he is aware, nature of self is awareness, and awareness is held, God finished.
